# Computational Notes

This section demonstrates reproducible scientific writing using Quarto. It is intended for mathematical derivations, executable examples, and numerical experiments.

## Topics

- Brownian motion and diffusion
- Markov chains and transition matrices
- Monte Carlo methods
- Statistical mechanics models
- Simulation and validation notes

## Example

$$
\frac{\partial p}{\partial t} = D \frac{\partial^2 p}{\partial x^2}
$$

This diffusion equation is the continuum analogue of a random walk and a key concept in many simulation studies.
